## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes (engine tests, then WebKit, Firefox and Chromium)
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change, in the engine tests and/or end to end
- [ ] Commit messages follow `type(scope): description` (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] If the interface text changed: updated in every language in `public/i18n.js`
- [ ] If behavior changed: README updated
- [ ] New controls have a name and a keyboard path
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies; programs are run with an argument list, never a shell
